text_to_image_prompt: Premium refined semi-realistic 2.5D/3D character render, sculpted beautiful face, delicate skin microtexture and subsurface scattering, crisp eyes, fine individual hair strands, richly detailed fabric and metal physically based materials. Pure opaque white seamless studio background, bright soft neutral frontal light with fill, no colored cast, no text, no labels, no border, no watermark. Preserve CG material finish, not a photograph or flat illustration. An adult man with dark brown short swept-back textured hair and a few loose forehead strands, gray eyes, harmonious softly tapered jaw, proportionate chin, elegant cheekbone planes, balanced midface, straight refined nose and natural closed rose lips. No mole near the mouth or lower cheek. Elegant chocolate-black three-piece suit, dark patterned tie, silver tie clip and satin pocket square. Calm sophisticated expression, natural masculine facial modeling with no excessively square jaw or hollow cheeks. Matching tailored chocolate-black straight suit trousers, dark polished leather Oxford shoes, slim black belt. Tall 191 cm slender athletic masculine build. Exactly nine head-and-shoulders portraits of this ONE SAME person in a clean 3 by 3 equal panel expression grid, every face front-facing eye-level same scale and consistent face hair clothes. Row1 neutral, gentle closed-mouth smile, happy open smile; row2 surprise mouth O, worried frown, quiet sadness; row3 focused anger, skeptical raised eyebrow, playful small wink. Expressions clearly distinct but attractive and natural. Full hair and shoulders inside each cell. Square overall canvas. Narrow white gutters, no text.
